results.title: The node at the checkpoint sequence is the one mutated
results.evidence: the node at seq 11 was rewritten; the full walk breaks at 11 and the incremental walk answers valid — correctly, because it asks a narrower question and SAYS SO: scope='incremental' from_seq=11 over 2 node(s). A reader taking that as 'the chain is intact' is reading a field that is not there
